universe.name: Layered Banknote Engraving Diorama
universe.why: The story is literally about a man whose name ended up on the nation's paper money. Telling his life story through the visual language of 19th-century currency engraving makes the medium the message.
universe.pacing: Deliberate, sweeping, like a printing press rolling out history.
universe.signature_shot: A giant engraved fountain pen signing a massive, flowing ribbon of paper money.
universe.medium_break: The penguin gets stuck in the cross-hatching lines and has to pull one like a guitar string to snap free.
universe.look_bible: 3D layered diorama made entirely of intaglio engraved paper. Fine cross-hatched linework in deep forest green, charcoal black, and cream parchment. Lighting is dramatic, casting soft shadows between the paper layers to emphasize depth. The texture is fibrous cotton paper with raised ink lines.
universe.penguin_render: Engraved paper cut-out penguin, cross-hatched shading, cream belly, dark green/black back, orange-tinted ink for feet/beak.
universe.music: Plucky strings and rhythmic mechanical percussion mimicking a printing press.

penguin.arc: Wants to help write the history, pushes the giant pen to sign the bill, but slips on the wet ink at the end.
